policy: READ-ONLY. claimbox writes the Lean intake's spec and its reading's table (claimbox/intake, lean/INTAKE.md §7–§8); this manifest copies them OUT into corpus/lean-intake/<id>-claimbox/, where tools/lean-intake.js reads them as it reads a hand-written spec, and never writes back. The copy is committed before the run (the pre-registration); PROVENANCE-claimbox-intake.json names the claimbox commit and every sha256; `make drift` re-hashes both ends. A separate manifest from LIFT-claimbox.json so that a lift here never re-copies the Riemann or x^x files. Extends the one exception to CLAUDE.md's 'nothing here reads claimbox' on the operator's go for the lane's L1 + L2 (2026-11-09).
